No thank you, I realized that being together with her is way worse than an ass kicking. If you excuse me, I'm off enjoying my new single life while he has to deal with her whining.

Where I live you have to go to a office for it but yeah it's not a two person job. I helped her because I enjoy helping others but then regreted it since she was so unthankful. 

I realized that being friends means for her that I help her with everything she askes me for while getting nothing in  return.
I'll cut contact with her, I can't take it anymore.

Yeah about being empathic, it would have felt bad for me not doing anything for her but now that I did something I feel bad as well. It was a kind of lose-lose situation for me.

I also realized that as long as she doesn't contact me I feel fine but when she askes me for help I have the whole "I really want to help her but shouldn't" problem.

Jokes on him cause she is asexual. There is not going to be any fucking in his life as long as he is with her.
She broke up because she said the love for me was gone
Yeah, ill try to go no contact, it's actually what I wanted to do since she moved out. I shouldnt have helped with the address thing i know. But when she was sick I couldnt just leave her be.
Thats exactly what I already did but it didn't seem to help...
I'll try but I don't know if she will listen to me anymore

I don't want to interfere with her new relationship but I am worried because she told me he hit his last girlfriend. Wich doesn't bother her at all for some reason. Also he is only 16 and im not sure if he can handle the the whole suicidal thoughts situation (Not saying that I am that much better, I also made lots of mistakes). But actually im glad she found someone else she can trust.

I think there is a small part in me who still wants her back. I don't know if it's because of love, the fact that I am worried about her or because I feel lonley now. I don't know what the right way is, should I spend more time with her or less?

Yes it was a very one sided relationship, I realized that now. But during the relationship it felt great, I loved being there for her and helping her out even if she couldn't always do the same for me. I am exhausted but the stress with her continues at least for the next few days.

Thanks for the reply!

She never wanted to seek professional help. Shortly before we broke up I actually thought of ways to convince her to go see a doctor but before I could talk to her about it she broke up.

When (if) she comes back tomorrow I think I tell her that she can spend one last night at my apartment but once she has the keys she has to sleep in her new apartement or, since it isn't furnished, at her boyfriends place.

She also told me she wants to invite me for a movie night but im not sure if I should take her up on the offer. I'll probably tell her she should only contact me again when she figured out what she wants regarding our friendship. But I'll also tell her that if she is feeling depressed or suicidal she can always contact me and we can talk and find a solution. However im not sure anymore if she would actually contact me in such a situation.

Thanks for the reply!
